Anime visual novel background, detailed digital painting, cool early-morning lighting with a warm low sun, no people, 1280x720, painterly brushwork. A camel racetrack in the desert outside Dubai just after sunrise (fictional, not a copy of any real track). In the foreground a packed sand track runs left to right, bordered by a low white rail fence; beyond it a parallel sand road for the trainers' cars, then the inner rail. In the middle distance a row of white sun-shade tents and a small open grandstand with a plain canopy; a few parked white SUVs in a line, no visible logos. Behind, long pale dunes and a huge clear sky turning from blue to gold at the horizon, a low sun casting long soft shadows across the sand. Quiet, wide, slightly hazy with fine dust in the air. No camels, no animals, no people, no text, no signboards with writing, no flags with emblems, no logos, no numbers, no watermark. Keep the center foreground open for a character overlay. Fine pixel-painter texture matching bg_eden_shop.png, not photographic, not glossy 3D. 16:9, 1280x720 (or 2048x1152 for downsampling), opaque.

Generate at 2048x1152, landscape 16:9. Reference image is for PIXEL-PAINTER STYLE ONLY; do not reproduce its interior or shisha objects. Candidate A: balanced wide establishing composition.

Game sprite sheet asset, strict side view facing right, high-density pixel-painter style matching the reference image's texture only (no thick outlines, no photo realism, no glossy 3D). A racing dromedary camel (one hump) in full gallop, light sand-colored coat, long legs, neck raised and head held forward. NO rider, NO saddle, NO robot on the camel in these frames. Exactly FOUR separate animation frames in a regular 2 by 2 grid on a fully transparent background: each equal cell contains ONE entire camel, same size, same position, identical body/head proportions, only legs, slight neck bob and tail change. Four clearly different successive running leg poses: extension, contact, gathered, push-off; all four anatomical legs belong to each camel, no extra legs. Each intended frame is 512x384, entire sheet 1024x768 or a larger exact 4:3 sheet for downsampling. Keep at least 10% transparent padding around each entire camel within each cell and align the body/hump position identically across cells. No grid lines, no frame borders, no text, no labels, no logos, no numbers, no ground shadow (the game draws shadows), no background, no scenery. Genuine alpha transparency.
Independent animation candidate A. Keep all four frames internally consistent.
